analysis.analysis: The Wound Gauge describes itself. 'The AI Overview Capture Registry (e.g., EA-WG-CAPTURES-01) is a longitudinal, open-access dataset tracking how Google's generative AI (AI Overviews, AI Mode, and knowledge panels) responds to specific long-tail and concept-based queries over time' (Zenodo +1). Expanded: Current Edition v6.1, 96 documented captures, four categories (Frameworks, Heteronyms, Sites & Surfaces, Books & Projects). 'Researchers and SEO analysts use it to observe compositional patterns (like how summarization basins vs. organic retrieval basins function) and entity disambiguation' (Zenodo +1). Links to Zenodo Archive, Leesharks.com, and Godkinggoogle Vercel. The composition layer accurately describes the instrument that documents it.
